segments.text:
V. 33.
Sell what ye have—This is a Direction, not given to all the Multitude; (much leſs is it a ſtanding Rule for all Chriſtians) neither to the Apoſtles; for they had Nothing to ſell, having left all before: But to his other Diſciples (mentioned ver. 22. and Acts i. 15.) eſpecially to the Seventy, that they might be free from all worldly Intanglements.
